notes: ONE PANEL THAT FOLDS - single display, role primary. Source is HP's own Product Spec Sheet PDF hosted on hp.com (press kit), which is primary and gives exact millimetres; HP QuickSpecs at h20195.www2.hp.com were not needed because this sheet already states both states to 0.01 mm. AXIS MAPPING: HP publishes both states in W x D x H order. Folded 277.05 x 191.31 x 21.4 mm -> closed.width 277.05, closed.height 191.31, closed.depth 21.4. Unfolded 277.05 x 376.1 x 8.5 mm -> open.width 277.05, open.height 376.1, open.depth 8.5. Manufacturer WIDTH -> width, DEPTH -> height, HEIGHT/thickness -> depth. NOTE this machine folds the OTHER WAY from the two ThinkPad X1 Folds: the width 277.05 mm is CONSTANT between states and the DEPTH halves (376.1 -> 191.31) while thickness roughly doubles (8.5 -> 21.4), consistent with a 3:4 portrait panel folding across its long axis; that pair is the evidence for hinge.axis. mass_g 1354 is HP's without-keyboard figure, stated directly in grams so NO conversion was applied; HP separately gives 1624 g with the detachable Bluetooth keyboard. This is a configured weight ('SSD, w/o KB'), not a 'starting at' range. DISPLAY: HP states the diagonal in centimetres first - '43.2 cm (17")' - and gives resolution in portrait order 1920 x 2560 with aspect 3:4, all internally consistent. active_area_mm derived from the sourced 17in diagonal + sourced resolution assuming square pixels: 1920x2560 is exactly 3:4, so w = 17 x 1920 / 3200 x 25.4 = 259.1 mm and h = 17 x 2560 / 3200 x 25.4 = 345.4 mm. refresh_hz null - HP's spec sheet states brightness (SDR 400 nits, HDR 500 nits) and gamut but NO refresh rate. max_angle_deg and free_stop null - HP describes 'a foldable panel and integrated hinge' but publishes no angle or free-stop rating. PORTS: only 2x Thunderbolt 4 USB-C; there is no headphone jack (HP's own battery-test footnote even says 'or through speaker (if no audio jack port)'), no HDMI, no card reader. Positions null. materials: 'Magnesium Alloy (A/D with embedded kickstand)' - A and D covers are the outer shells, so the same value is recorded for frame and back; cover_glass null, HP names no cover glass. released null - HP says pre-order 2023-09-14 and general availability 'in October', which is not a full date.
